items.title: 52300_Trummy Young oral history interview
items.q: I had Dexter Gordon, Curly Russell and Denzil Best on drums, Jimmy Jones was on piano.

ctx.x: Whom did you have in your band?
Well, I told you last night, one band I had -- I had Dexter Gordon, Curly Russell and Denzil Best on drums, Jimmy Jones was on piano. Guess that was about it, about five of us, small band.
